login.hero:
Send one stream.
Go live everywhere.
login.heroText: Ingest over SRT or RTMP and distribute to YouTube, Facebook, Twitch and your own servers, each in the right bitrate.
login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Access the {{name}} control console
login.forgot: Forgotten your password? Ask an administrator to reset it.
login.mfaText: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.

setup2fa.title: Set up two-factor authentication
setup2fa.text: Two-factor authentication is required. Scan this QR code with an authenticator app such as Microsoft Authenticator, Google Authenticator, 1Password or Bitwarden.
setup2fa.manual: Can't scan? Enter this key manually:
setup2fa.codesText: Each code works once if you lose access to your authenticator app. Store them somewhere safe; they will not be shown again.

changePassword.title: Choose a new password
changePassword.forced: Your administrator set a temporary password. Choose your own to continue.
changePassword.hint: At least 12 characters. A short sentence works well.
changePassword.done: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.

dashboard.title: Live control
dashboard.phaseText: Sign-in, users, 2FA, languages and updates are in place. Ingest, destinations and Go live arrive in the next release (phase 1).
dashboard.previewEmpty: Waiting for an incoming SRT or RTMP stream

soon.title: Coming in phase {{phase}}
soon.text: This part of Restream is planned and will appear here after an update.

users.title: Users & 2FA
users.subtitle: Everyone signs in with their own account. All users share the same streams and settings.
users.passwordHint: Leave empty to generate a temporary password. The user must change it at first sign-in.
users.tempPasswordText: Give this password to {{email}}. It is shown only once.
users.confirmReset2fa: Reset 2FA for {{email}}? They will set it up again at the next sign-in.

account.title: My account
account.newCodesText: Enter a current code from your app to generate new recovery codes. Old codes stop working.
account.ssoManaged: Your account is managed by Microsoft 365. Password and 2FA are handled there.

settings.title: Settings
settings.publicUrlHint: The address users open, e.g. https://restream.example.com. Needed for Microsoft sign-in.
settings.githubTokenHint: Only needed when the repository is private. Leave empty to keep the current value.
settings.ssoText: Let technicians sign in with their Microsoft 365 (Entra ID) work account. Multi-factor is then enforced by Microsoft.
settings.secretSet: A secret is stored. Leave empty to keep it.
settings.allowedGroupHint: Optional. Only members of this Entra group may sign in. Requires the groups claim in the app registration.
settings.autoProvision: Create accounts automatically at first sign-in
settings.redirectUri: Redirect URI for the app registration
settings.ssoHelp: In Entra ID: App registrations → New registration → Web → paste the redirect URI below. Create a client secret under Certificates & secrets.

updates.title: Updates
updates.subtitle: Restream updates itself from GitHub. Production follows the main branch, test follows the test branch.
updates.available: An update is available on the {{channel}} channel.
updates.switchText: Switching installs the latest build of that channel. Test builds may contain unfinished features.
updates.confirmInstall: Install the latest {{channel}} build now? Restream restarts for a few seconds; live streams are interrupted.
updates.unavailable: The updater is not installed on this server (development mode). Use the installer on Debian 13.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: The last 200 security and configuration events.

errors.account_locked: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission for this.
errors.email_taken: A user with this email already exists.
errors.last_admin: There must be at least one active administrator.
errors.cannot_delete_self: You can't delete your own account.
errors.cannot_demote_self: You can't remove your own admin role or disable yourself.
errors.updater_unavailable: The updater is not available on this server.
errors.sso_failed: Microsoft sign-in failed. Try again or use your password.
errors.sso_not_allowed: Your Microsoft account is not in the allowed group.
errors.sso_no_account: No Restream account exists for this Microsoft user.
errors.too_many_requests: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.
